envelope.description: Cross-repository results leave out a repository under index; search.query skips it

body.title: Cross-repository results leave out a repository under index; search.query skips it
body.summary: src/daemon/index.ts: results that follow the graph or a closure across repositories (search.callers, search.callees, search.callers_nhop, entity.closure, entity.unreachable, search.closure through resolveClosure, repo.depends_on and repo.search_cross_repo through the DEPENDS_ON closure) leave out the entities or repositories under index; search.query leaves repositories under index out of the set it searches and answers from the others, without refusing.
acceptanceChecks: search.callers for an entity in a ready repository whose callers include entities of a repository being indexed returns the callers from the ready repository only.

entity.closure, entity.unreachable, search.closure, repo.depends_on and repo.search_cross_repo from a ready repository whose closure reaches a repository under index leave that repository's entities out.
search.query while one repository is being indexed returns rows from the other repositories only.
